source.branch: After a successful breamm breath-admission draw, C calls dobuzz and draws rn1(7,7) for beam range. JavaScript breamm currently skips dobuzz, so the next cooldown draw occurs in its place. Existing dobuzz implements only some ray types and must be completed, with all return-used zhitm and zap_over_floor paths, before wiring the monster-breath caller.
callers: nethack-c/upstream/src/mthrowu.c:breamm() dispatches a selected monster breath into zap.c dobuzz(), preserving the monster buzzer and target direction, then performs cooldown draws.
nethack-c/upstream/src/zap.c:dobuzz(), lines 4780-5037, owns beam range, map traversal, reflection, creature hits, terrain effects, bouncing and final explosion/shop handling.
js/mthrowu.js:breamm() currently records note_unported(zap.c dobuzz); js/zap.js has a partial dobuzz owner used by other ray callers.
dependencies: zhitm() returns damage and an optional destroyed armor object; implement every damage-type branch and required return-valued callees, including electrical item destruction and hero spell bonuses.
zap_over_floor() returns range adjustments and shop damage; preserve terrain changes, trap activation, visibility snapshots, Norep messages, existing gas/object/timeout owners and source RNG order.

The fountain.c dryup/watchman_warn_fountain dependency is accepted in tested main 17c7e13e. Worker A merged published main and now calls that canonical owner with the live/planning state and message context.
Planning and live execution must use the same state and RNG owners; forward message/redraw callbacks through the beam helpers without drawing to the live terminal from a clone.
